description: ALBANY, GA – 2nd District Congressman Sanford Bishop’s campaign released its first TV ad of the cycle this week featuring elected Sheriffs from three counties in the 2nd District acknowledging Bishop as a “leader who supports law enforcement.” With major concerns about crime in our communities and across the country,…
